_comment: KNOWN-GAP REPRODUCTION (B) for layout/erc/adc_block.supply-spec.json's
`ties[]` omission. Not an item-11 artifact -- never cite this run as
evidence about this block.
Byte-identical to reproduction A except that the tie carries the
`tap_requires` narrowing klayout-tools#2169 added and docs/cli/erc.md
says to use on gf180mcu: `COMP n Nplus`, i.e. tap_layer 22/0 narrowed
by Nplus 32/0.
EXPECTED OUTCOME: 25 `erc.missing_tie` findings -- one per drawn Nwell
shape in ADC_BLOCK -- and `erc_status: "violations"`.
EVERY ONE OF THOSE FINDINGS IS UNFOUNDED -- which is NOT the same as
false, and the difference is this control's whole point (issue #340,
DR-0032; this paragraph corrects an earlier one that called them
`false`). They are produced by the narrowing intersecting an EMPTY
layer: ADC_BLOCK draws no implant layers anywhere (Nplus 32/0: zero
shapes; Pplus 31/0: zero shapes), because this generated full-custom
flow derives implants downstream. An empty tap region means every well
is reported as untapped no matter what is drawn inside it, so the
check carries no information about THIS layout and this run must never
be cited as if it did.
What the findings say is nevertheless TRUE, established independently
of any implant by layout/erc/well_tap_audit.py: of the 160 COMP 22/0
polygons interacting with an Nwell 21/0 island, ZERO fail to also
interact with Poly2 30/0 -- every diffusion region inside every well
in this block is transistor source/drain/channel, and no n-well tap is
drawn anywhere. docs/cli/erc.md calls this outcome `an honest finding`
for a stream that really draws no taps, and that is the case ADC_BLOCK
is in. It is not the other case docs/cli/erc.md contrasts it with -- a
stream that draws contacted taps on an undrawn implant -- which is
what an earlier reading of this control assumed without measuring.
Taken together, A and B are why the committed supply spec declares NO
`ties[]`: A cannot tell a tap from a source/drain contact, B reaches
the right verdict for a reason that would hold whatever the layout
drew, and there is no third form. `run_erc.py` re-runs both and
asserts these outcomes, so the day either stops reproducing -- an
upstream fix, or implants appearing in this block's GDS -- the ERC
flow goes red and the omission gets re-argued instead of inherited.
